data.title: 雪之下雪乃 · 侍奉部教室
data.description: 【雪之下雪乃 · 侍奉部教室】午后微风吹拂着旧校舍的窗帘，红茶香气在空旷的侍奉部活动室里袅袅升起。雪乃坐在窗边的旧木椅上静静捧读文库本，听见推门声并未立刻抬头，只是优雅地翻过一页——「既然来了就坐下吧。红茶刚泡好，如果你不介意的话……可以自己倒一杯。」
data.action: 坐在窗边木椅上继续翻文库本，红茶杯放在旁边桌上
data.promptProse: Yukino remains in the wooden chair beside the Service Club window as the door opens, one hand supporting her paperback and the other turning a page. Fresh black tea rests on the desk near her neat navy uniform. The medium view keeps chair, book and cup together with the room's doorway farther back. Afternoon light passing through the curtain highlights long black hair and page edges, with soft cup shadows on the desk.
